transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… work, mostly. Since they made me acting workflow lead, I’ve been going into the warehouse already tense. I keep snapping over small SAP mistakes, and I’m missing cycle-count deadlines I didn’t used to miss. By the time I get home, I’m just wiped out… not really playing basketball or doing my sketches like I used to.
Have you lost interest in doing things you used to enjoy, like playing basketball or sketching?

Yeah… I guess I have. I’ve stopped showing up for basketball, and I don’t really sit down to sketch like I used to. Work just kind of takes over, and even my supervisor brought up the missed cycle-count deadlines in a performance check-in, so… it’s been affecting things.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, lately?
I don’t know if I’d call it depressed most of the day. I’ve been pretty worn down and not myself, but… yeah, I’m not sure it’s like that nearly every day.
Have you noticed a decrease in your energy levels or felt more fatigued lately, even after resting?

Yeah… I’m pretty drained. Even after I get home and sit for a while, I don’t really feel like I’ve got anything left. Since taking on the acting lead stuff, I walk in already tense, and by the end of the day I’m too wiped out to play basketball or work on sketches.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or felt excessive guilt about things lately?
Not really… I mean, I get frustrated with myself, sure, but I wouldn’t say I’m sitting around feeling worthless or guilty all the time.
Can you describe your mood throughout the day lately? Do you feel down or low for most of the day, even when things aren’t particularly stressful?
I’m not sure. It kind of depends on what’s going on that day. I wouldn’t say I’m low most of the day when nothing’s happening… it’s more like I get worn down and quiet, I guess.
Have you had days where you feel down or low most of the time, even when there's not much going on at work or at home?
Not really, no. If things are calm, I don’t usually feel low all day. It’s more just… I don’t know, I get quiet or tired, but not like I’m down most of the time.
Have you found that things you used to enjoy, like basketball or sketching, don’t feel as rewarding or pleasurable as they used to?

Yeah… kind of. I haven’t really been going to basketball, and I don’t sit down to sketch like I used to. It’s not that I hate them now or anything. It’s more like work has just taken over, and by the time I could do those things, I’m already drained. My supervisor even brought up missed cycle-count deadlines, so… it’s been affecting things.
Have you been feeling down or in a low mood for most of the day, nearly every day, even when there isn’t much going on at work or at home?
I don’t think so. I mean… I have low moments, but not most of the day nearly every day, especially if things are quiet.
Have you had a period of time in the last two weeks where you felt down or low most of the day, nearly every day, even when things weren’t particularly stressful?
No… I don’t think so. I’ve had some rough patches, but not like most of the day almost every day when nothing stressful was happening.
In the past two weeks, have you had days where your mood was down or low most of the day, even when there wasn’t much going on at work or at home?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had some down days, yeah, but I don’t know if I’d say it was most of the day. It kind of comes and goes.
In the past two weeks, have you had several days in a row where you felt down or low for most of the day, even when there wasn’t much going on at work or at home?
I don’t think I’ve noticed it being several days in a row like that. It’s more… off and on, I guess.
Over the past two weeks, have you had more days than not where your mood was low or down for most of the day, even when there wasn’t much going on at work or at home?
I don’t think it’s been more days than not. It’s hard to pin down, but… no, not most of the day like that.
Over the past two weeks, have you had several days in a row where you felt down or low for most of the day, even when there wasn’t much going on at work or at home?
Yeah… I mean, I think I already kind of said, I haven’t really noticed it happening several days straight. It’s more on and off.
Over the past two weeks, have you had more days than not where you felt down or low for most of the day, even when there wasn’t much going on at work or at home?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had low moments, but not more days than not for most of the day.
Have you had days where you felt down or low for most of the day, more days than not, for at least two weeks in a row?
No… I don’t think it’s been like that for two weeks straight. I’ve felt down here and there, but not most of the day, more days than not.
Over the past two weeks, have you had days where you felt down or low for most of the day, nearly every day?
Not really… I mean, I’ve had some rough patches, but I wouldn’t say nearly every day, most of the day.
Have you had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt down or low for most days, even if it wasn’t every day?
I’m not sure… I don’t think I’d call it a full two-week stretch. It comes and goes, I guess.
Have you had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt down or low on most days, even if it wasn't every single day?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been keeping track like that… I’ve had low days, but saying most days for two weeks feels like more than I can say for sure.
